chapters.card:
1 · Connect Google Drive and GitHub
inside Higgsfield Supercomputer

2 · Put the shared brand folders
in your own Drive (Organize → Add shortcut)

3 · Test it — new chat, + → Connectors,
ask for the brand folder

4 · Clone the tools repo
(paste the link, say "clone this")

5 · Get updates —
"Pull my GitHub repository and look for updates"

6 · Where the briefs live —
the brand folder in Drive

7 · The workflow —
review, remove slop, reroll, sequence, edit
8 · Turn the pull into a skill

9 · Execute a brief —
pull up its clips
10 · Pull in the AI video production workflows
